# registry_module_reanalyze (Resource)

Triggers re-analysis of a module version (terraform-docs, scanning, SCM verification). Recreates whenever triggers change; otherwise no-op on subsequent applies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Re-runs analysis (terraform-docs, scanning, SCM verification) for a module
# version. Change a value in triggers to run it again.
resource "registry_module_reanalyze" "vpc_1_2_0" {
  namespace = "my-org"
  name      = "vpc"
  system    = "aws"
  version   = "1.2.0"

  triggers = {
    scanner_version = "0.58.0"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Module name.
- `namespace` (String) Module namespace.
- `system` (String) Module system (provider name).
- `version` (String) Module version to reanalyze.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value map. Changing any value forces the reanalyze action to run again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier: {namespace}/{name}/{system}/{version}.
